hub.title: Short Final guides: air traffic control, explained
hub.description: Plain-English guides to air traffic control, holding patterns, airport codes, weather and live flight tracking, from Thin Air Studios.
hub.lead: How planes are guided from takeoff to touchdown, what controllers say on the radio, and how the real sky reaches Short Final. Each guide ends with a way to try the idea.
hub.classroomLink: The classroom page has three lesson ideas for teachers and clubs.
toc.label: In this guide
demo.heading: Try it yourself
demo.body: The free browser demo opens {airport} with simulated planes. It runs one game per visit and needs no install.
play.heading: Play Short Final on Android
play.body: Short Final is free on Google Play. Pick any of more than 29,000 airports, and real planes from live flight data come in when the feed has them. The 50 busiest airports ship inside the app, so they open even offline.
play.button: Get Short Final on Google Play
related.heading: Keep reading
busiest.caption: ACI World, 2025 results, as listed in Short Final. Passengers are in millions.
